payout_quote: Earn up to $300 when you join Arsenal Credit Union. Use promo code New2026 when opening your account(s) to activate the offer.
steps: Join Arsenal Credit Union and open a new savings account plus a Totally Free Checking account with a debit card, using promo code New2026 at opening
Make at least ten (10) debit card transactions to earn the $100 tier
Add a direct deposit of any amount to the account and create a new online banking account to reach the $200 tier
The incentive is paid by the credit union within 30 days after promotional requirements are met
catches: The advertised $300 tier requires opening a credit card or loan of any type - a debt product with a hard inquiry; the achievable bonus without taking on debt is $100-$200
Membership eligibility required (St. Louis metro area IL/MO, plus family of current members); 18+
$5 minimum savings deposit required to join; credit will be reviewed at account opening
Member must remain in good standing; cannot be combined with other offers
Offer valid until 12/31/2026; bonus reported as taxable income/dividend
If the savings and checking accounts are closed within six months of opening, the credit union may claw back the bonus at closing
biggest_catch: The top $300 tier requires opening a credit card or loan - taking on debt - so the real bonus for someone just opening accounts is $100 (10 debit transactions) or $200 (adding direct deposit + online banking).
eligibility: New Arsenal Credit Union members eligible for membership (St. Louis metro area IL/MO and family of current members), 18+; promo code New2026 used at account opening; accounts opened by 12/31/2026.
timing: Incentive paid via deposit into an Arsenal savings account within 30 days after all promotional requirements are met.

c1.evidence: Arsenal Credit Union - real operating credit union (St. Louis, MO area); official promo page on arsenalcu.com.

c2.evidence: Official Arsenal page '$300 New Member Promo' with promo code New2026, three tier definitions ($100/$200/$300), and official rules PDF with payout timing and 12/31/2026 expiry.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; $100 and $200 tiers earned by opening accounts and using the debit card/direct deposit; $5 minimum savings is a membership share, not a fee.

c4.evidence: Official rules: 'The incentive will be paid by the credit union (via direct deposit into an Arsenal savings account) within 30 days of account opening after all conditions have been met.'

s1.note: New members only (must join to earn); membership eligibility in St. Louis metro IL/MO + family of members; 18+; code New2026 at opening.

s2.note: Concrete: $100 = savings + checking + debit card + 10 debit transactions; $200 = $100 steps + any-amount DD + online banking; $300 adds a loan/credit card.

s3.note: Paid within 30 days after requirements met; bonus reported as taxable income; clawback if accounts closed within 6 months.

s4.note: Honest tiered 'up to $300' framing; $300 tier is debt-gated and disclosed as the biggest catch rather than promised.

s5.note: https://arsenalcu.com/300-new-member-promo/ and official rules PDF - official Arsenal pages, fetched 2026-09-23 (UTC).
